title: GISTIC copy-number landscapes
text: MutGlyph accepts GISTIC object produced maftools::readGistic(). example uses small TCGA acute myeloid leukemia GISTIC result bundled maftools. two profiles use G-score domain, making amplification deletion magnitudes directly comparable. Intervals passing fdrCutOff drawn amplification deletion color; intervals use opaque context color. Drawing every interval exactly avoids alpha-blending artifacts narrow rectangles overlap. default, five significant cytobands lowest q-values labelled.
code: library(MutGlyph)  gistic <- maftools::readGistic(   gisticDir = system.file("extdata", package = "maftools"),   isTCGA = TRUE,   verbose = FALSE ) gisticChromPlot(gistic, height = 300)

title: GISTIC copy-number landscapes
text: Use markBands = "" label every significant cytoband, supply selected names. familiar maftools arguments retain usual meaning fit interactive composition. Custom genomic annotations supplied regular data frame. narrowest high-scoring intervals overlap KMT2A ERG. coordinates corresponding NCBI RefSeq gene ranges GRCh37/hg19 (KMT2A, ERG). Labels placed highest G-score interval overlapping range. Hovering score interval reports genomic coordinates, G-score, q-value, mean amplitude, alteration frequency. Cytoband labels provide peak-level q-values sample gene counts. compact score summary fields embedded; large sample-level lesion matrix omitted HTML widget.
code: gene_annotations <- data.frame(   chromosome = c("chr11", "chr21"),   start = c(118307207, 39739183),   end = c(118397547, 40033707),   label = c("KMT2A", "ERG"),   event_type = c("Amp", "Amp") )  gisticChromPlot(   gistic,   fdrCutOff = 0.05,   markBands = c("5q31.2", "7q32.3", "17q11.2"),   annotations = gene_annotations,   color = c(Amp = "#E45756", Del = "#4C78A8"),   nonSignificantColor = "lightgray",   height = 300 )

title: Oncoplots
text: Custom bars use two-column data frame. first column identifies sample gene; numeric second column supplies value name becomes axis title. numeric clinical field name can used directly top bar. Custom top right data replace default stacked summaries. custom left bar adds new gene-aligned column. Missing displayed keys shown zero reported warning.
code: genes <- as.character(maftools::getGeneSummary(laml)$Hugo_Symbol[1:10])  variants <- maftools::subsetMaf(   laml,   genes = genes,   fields = c("Hugo_Symbol", "i_TumorVAF_WU"),   includeSyn = FALSE,   mafObj = FALSE )  mean_vaf <- aggregate(i_TumorVAF_WU ~ Hugo_Symbol, variants, mean) names(mean_vaf) <- c("gene", "Mean VAF (%)") oncoplot(   laml,   genes = genes,   keepGeneOrder = TRUE,   topBarData = "days_to_last_followup",   leftBarData = mean_vaf,   leftBarLims = c(0, 100),   titleText = "Follow-up and mean variant allele frequency",   height = 440 )

title: Plot GISTIC scores across the genome — gisticChromPlot
text: gistic maftools GISTIC object created maftools::readGistic(). fdrCutOff GISTIC q-value cutoff (0, 1] used assign two opaque score colors. markBands Cytobands label, "" every significant band, NULL five bands lowest q-values. color Two colors amplification deletion. unnamed vector interpreted order; named vector must contain Amp Del. ref.build Reference assembly: "hg18", "hg19", "hg38". txtSize Relative cytoband-label size. cytobandTxtSize Relative chromosome-label size. y_lims Optional two-element increasing range. largest absolute value sets common amplification/deletion G-score limit. chromosomeTrack Chromosome context: "strip" draws compact chromosome bar profiles; "axis" omits bar draws regular genomic axis deletion profile. latter useful inspecting closely zoomed region. region Optional initial genomic region "chr21:39000000-41000000", chromosome "chr21". Commas whitespace coordinates accepted. endpoints may span chromosomes, example "chr3:43393228-chr4:8534670". plot remains zoomable. nonSignificantColor One color applied event types, two colors amplification deletion intervals pass fdrCutOff. unnamed vector interpreted order; named vector must contain Amp Del. default color, defaults opaque pale red blue resembling former translucent colors. color customized, fallback "lightgray" . annotations Optional data frame custom genomic labels columns chromosome, start, end, label, event_type. Event type must "Amp" "Del". Labels anchored highest overlapping G-score interval. width, height Widget dimensions. elementId Optional element ID.

text: Creates GenomeSpy protein-mutation lollipop plot maftools MAF object ordinary data frame. basic layout follows maftools::lollipopPlot(), displaced layout separates dense hotspots connects every marker back true protein position.

title: Draw an interactive protein lollipop plot — lollipopPlot
code: lollipopPlot(   maf,   data = NULL,   gene = NULL,   AACol = NULL,   labelPos = NULL,   labPosSize = 0.9,   showMutationRate = TRUE,   showDomainLabel = TRUE,   refSeqID = NULL,   proteinID = NULL,   colors = NULL,   domains = NULL,   proteinLength = NULL,   layout = c("basic", "displaced"),   count = c("events", "samples"),   minCount = NULL,   yScale = NULL,   showLegend = TRUE,   collapsePosLabel = TRUE,   labPosAngle = 0,   pointSize = 1.5,   topPadding = NULL,   width = NULL,   height = NULL,   elementId = NULL )

title: Draw an interactive protein lollipop plot — lollipopPlot
text: maf maftools MAF object. data Optional mutation data frame, following maftools::lollipopPlot(). MutGlyph accepts two-column position/count convention well named position, mutation, variant_class (classification), sample, gene, count columns. gene One gene symbol. Required MAF input; optional custom data frame contains exactly one value gene column. AACol Optional column containing protein changes. MAF input, HGVSp_Short, Protein_Change, AAChange tried order. labelPos Amino-acid positions label, "". displaced layout labels mutations default; basic layout labels none. labPosSize Relative mutation-label size, matching maftools' cex semantics. showMutationRate Include mutated-sample fraction title. showDomainLabel Draw ranged labels inside protein domains. refSeqID, proteinID Optional RefSeq transcript protein identifier. retain maftools' domain-selection semantics. compatible RefSeq metadata present mutation input, MutGlyph warns mixed mismatching isoforms without silently filtering mutations. colors Optional named character vector overriding mutation-class colors. domains Optional custom domain data frame start, end, label columns. description protein_length optional. proteinLength Optional protein length amino acids. layout Either "basic" true-position vertical lollipops "displaced" collision-aware markers, labels, connectors. count Use mutation "events" (maftools convention) distinct tumor "samples" recurrence heights. pre-aggregated data frame, also defines count column represents. minCount Minimum plotted recurrence selected count mode. NULL, basic layout uses one displaced layout uses two. yScale "linear" "log". NULL, basic plots use linear displaced plots use logarithmic scaling. showLegend Show mutation-class legend. collapsePosLabel Combine mutation labels amino-acid position, example D835Y/H. Used basic layout. labPosAngle Mutation-label angle degrees. Positive values rotate counterclockwise, maftools. Used basic layout. pointSize Relative marker-size multiplier, matching maftools' linear cex semantics. topPadding Vertical space pixels reserved mutation panel mutation labels. NULL, basic layout uses 10 pixels displaced layout uses 70 pixels. width, height Widget dimensions. elementId Optional element ID.

title: Draw an interactive protein lollipop plot — lollipopPlot

Selected transcript protein identifiers shown plot title. Mutation event distinct-sample counts retained plot$x$spec$datasets$mutations, irrespective one plotted.

title: Draw an interactive protein lollipop plot — lollipopPlot
code: if (interactive()) {   laml <- maftools::read.maf(     maf = system.file("extdata", "tcga_laml.maf.gz", package = "maftools"),     verbose = FALSE   )   # Frozen InterPro representative-domain matches for UniProt P36888.   # Fetch current matches with mutglyph_interpro_domains("P36888").   flt3_domains <- data.frame(     start = c(246, 438, 564, 756),     end = c(357, 531, 695, 958),     label = c("Ig-like", "Ig-like", "Kinase N", "Kinase C"),     protein_length = 993   )   lollipopPlot(     laml,     gene = "FLT3",     AACol = "Protein_Change",     domains = flt3_domains,     layout = "displaced"   ) }

title: Draw an interactive rainfall plot — rainfallPlot
text: maf maftools MAF object. tsb One tumor sample barcode. NULL, mutated sample selected. detectChangePoints Detect annotate potential kataegis loci using maftools criterion: least six consecutive mutations average intermutation distance greater 1,000 bp. ref.build Reference assembly: "hg18", "hg19", "hg38". color Optional named character vector overriding colors six pyrimidine substitution classes. savePlot Retained maftools API familiarity. TRUE unsupported; use widget's Save SVG button instead. width, height Widget dimensions. Unlike maftools, describe PDF device. fontSize Relative font-size multiplier. pointSize Relative mutation-point size. region Optional initial genomic region "chr8:98000000-98500000", chromosome "chr8". Commas whitespace coordinates accepted. endpoints may span chromosomes, example "chr3:43393228-chr4:8534670". plot remains zoomable. elementId Optional element ID.

title: Draw an interactive rainfall plot — rainfallPlot
text: MutGlyph htmlwidget.

title: Draw an interactive rainfall plot — rainfallPlot
text: SNP records plotted, including synonymous variants. Substitutions normalized six pyrimidine classes. Inter-event distances calculated independently within chromosome, chromosome boundaries create artificial distances. detectChangePoints = TRUE, detected kataegis intervals shaded marked upward arrows. complete locus table retained plot$x$spec$datasets$kataegis files written side effect.

title: Draw an interactive rainfall plot — rainfallPlot
code: if (interactive()) {   brca <- maftools::read.maf(     maf = system.file("extdata", "brca.maf.gz", package = "maftools"),     verbose = FALSE   )   rainfallPlot(brca, detectChangePoints = TRUE) }
